title: Leo/need Chapter1 Episode4 Two is Still Lonely

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's celebrate my joining the soft tennis club with bubble tea! Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Cheers! It's good you found a club you like.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks for tagging along and checking them out with me!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
You know, you should take it easy at first.
The club captain said it's a very relaxed club, but you haven't done any sports in a while.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: True! The club captain and the student advisor seemed really nice, didn't they?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was worried they'd be against me joining a sports club since I'm probably not going to be much use after being ill for such a long time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki, you shouldn't think like that...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Anyway! Becoming a member of a school club is the first step in my wonderful high school life!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup! I've been wanting to go for bubble tea with friends after school for so long! I missed the peak of the bubble tea craze, but never mind!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Back when everyone was talking about how awesome bubble tea was, I was subsisting on bland hospital food...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Well, I'm fine now, so I'm going to gorge myself on all sorts of delicious things!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Like that apple pie we shared once.
Do you remember?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You know, back when we were in elementary.
You were obsessed with Miku songs and had us try playing together. Does that jog your memory?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Ah, yes. Honami learned to play drums in the school brass band, so we all brought instruments and met up at your house.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes! We got so excited about starting a band! But you know how that went.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It was all over the place.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But Shiho got so into it, she said we had to practice until we could play the song perfectly! Nothing could change her mind.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
So we carried on until everyone was exhausted, and then Hona said she brought us an apple pie to share.
It tasted divine.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It feels a bit lonely. Just the two of us.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I knew Saki would want to hang out with our old group.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(If only I could make that happen...
But it doesn't seem doable at this point...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? Did my phone just flash?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hello! You look sad. Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Wh-What?! Is this...a hologram?
Are you... Miku?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes, that's me.
It's nice to meet you, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Sorry, if I surprised you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I came to say hello, and to invite you over.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You can bring others along, if you'd like.
Your friends, for example.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'll be waiting for you in SEKAI. Bye, Ichika!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I can't get the hologram to reappear.
How did it even get on my phone in the first place?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(She looked just like the Miku in my dream.
I wonder if the two are connected somehow...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But... It'd be fun to get the band together again, and have Miku singing with us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Do you have time after school today? Because—

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: H-Hi! Did you get your homework done this time?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Why are they both being like that?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi... Did something happen when I was in hospital?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Never mind! I guess I just caught them at a bad time.
I'll try again sometime later!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was wondering, do you still listen to Miku?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Saki noticed that something's not right, but she's not asking about it because she doesn't want to upset me.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I feel so bad for her. She hasn't done anything wrong.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That's cool! So, what's hot recently?
Can you recommend some songs?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Sure. Take a look at this playlist.
Anything in here is pretty good.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: There's a song called Untitled? What's this one about?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Untitled? I don't remember adding that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What was that... Saki, are you all right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It looks like we're in a classroom...
